Bản trước của mục này viết rằng càng nhi: The previous version of this section said that the more methods signal the same direction, the worse the entry (−{0}R, −{1}R, −{2}R), and that the model scored +{3}R out of sample. Both figures were wrong because of leakage: the count only included signals that later got filled. Counted correctly, over every signal as in live running (gold from {4}, take profit at {5}R): with no other method in the same direction within {6} hours, the average is −{7}R per trade ({8}% wins); with one, −{9}R; with two or more, −{10}R ({11}% wins). The differences are small and inconsistent across periods, and all three groups lose. So multiple methods agreeing does not make an entry more reliable, nor clearly worse. CFD (hợp đồng chênh lệch) là hợp đồng gi: A CFD (contract for difference) is a contract between you and the broker: the two sides settle the price difference between opening and closing the trade. You don’t own the underlying asset (no real gold, shares or bitcoin), but you can sell first as easily as you buy, and you only need to put up margin for part of the value. Spot Forex at retail brokers essentially works like a CFD on exchange rates.

Các bài báo về dự báo tài chính đòi hai: Papers on financial forecasting require two things that ordinary measurement often skips: the error must account for trades clustering in time, and for having tried many setups before picking one. When this test was applied to the model scores, the top {0}% of scores at first showed +{1}R per signal, while the trading simulation was negative. Tracing it revealed leakage: during training, the consensus feature counted only signals that later got filled, and whether a pending order gets filled is information from the future. In live running the page counts every signal, so the model learned one thing and was used on another.
